outbound.http.title: HTTP Settings

outbound.http.userAgentHint: Custom text appended to the HTTP User-Agent header
outbound.http.timeoutHint: Seconds to wait for a connection (1-3600). Leave blank to use the system default.
outbound.http.retriesHint: Number of retry attempts (0-10). Leave blank to use the system default.

outbound.http.excludeText: Hosts reached without the proxy. Use the wildcard (*) in patterns.
outbound.http.hostPatternHint: A host name or pattern to exclude

outbound.http.problems.timeout: The timeout must be between 1 and 3600 seconds
outbound.http.problems.hostShape: Enter a host name or IP address without a scheme or path

outbound.email.title: Email Server

outbound.ssl.title: SSL Certificates
outbound.ssl.description: Manage the trusted SSL certificates of the Astrum truststore
outbound.ssl.filter: Filter by name, organization or fingerprint
outbound.ssl.name: Name
outbound.ssl.whatText: Using SSL to talk to the repository manager is an important security measure and a recommended practice. Secure connections can be inbound or outbound. Outbound connections include proxy repositories, email servers and LDAPS servers. Inbound connections include browser access over HTTPS, tool access to repository content and REST API calls. See our {link} for more information.

outbound.ssl.serverRequired: Enter a host name or URL
outbound.ssl.serverInvalid: Enter a host name, host:port or URL
